headings.title: Chapter definitions
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 read in full: eleven defined terms (board, embalmer, funeral establishment, preneed agent, provider, seller, etc.) apply "unless the context requires otherwise".

headings.title: Initial embalmer license qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 read with subdivisions (1)-(5): age, education, exams, apprenticeship with 25 embalmings, and definitions of apprentice program and direct supervision; applies except where 333.051 or 324.009 entitle applicant.

headings.title: Optional National Board Arts examination
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 permits licensees to sit for the Arts exam on written request if not previously passed.

headings.title: New application after five years
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 requires a new application, with no credit for earlier fees, if the process is not completed within five years of program completion.

headings.title: Combined funeral director and embalmer licenses
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 says a person qualified under this section and 333.042 "may" be granted both licenses.

headings.title: Funeral director license qualifications
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 1 covers general qualifications and two routes: accredited education with exams, or provisional license with 12-month/10 services or 18-month/25 services apprentice tracks, plus the pre-2023 Missouri arts exam acceptance.

headings.title: Provisional licensee examinations
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 2 lets provisional holders request the Arts and Missouri law exams during the provisional license period.

headings.title: Optional Arts exam for licensed directors
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 3 permits licensed directors not previously tested to sit for the Arts exam.

headings.title: Limited cremation funeral director license
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 4 covers limited license for cremation-licensed establishments, qualifications, and no apprentice program requirement.

headings.title: Discretionary six-month waiver when funeral director dies or is disabled
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 covers board-discretion waiver up to six months, for specified persons, excluding services requiring formal education.

headings.title: Personal supervision and apprentice program terms
headings.reviewNote: Subsection 6 defines two terms for this section only.

headings.reviewNote: Covers the permissive 'may' complaint to the administrative hearing commission for any of 23 numbered grounds as archived: (16) ends '; or' before (17), and (22) reads 'Failure to refuse to properly guard'; retained without correction. Navigation summary only.

headings.reviewNote: Covers the board's option to seek a Cole County injunction against a seller for preneed trust shortfalls over twenty percent, plus the court's power to suspend or revoke licenses.

headings.reviewNote: Subsection 5 covers reapplication wait and board discretion.

headings.title: Relationship to section 333.335 subsection 2
